name: kb
description: Native desktop knowledge management app built on Electrobun

scripts.cleanup: bun run clean && rm -rf node_modules bun.lock*
scripts.reinstall: bun run cleanup && mise exec -- bun install
scripts.lint:knip:ci: mkdir -p tmp/reports/linters && bunx knip --reporter compact > tmp/reports/linters/knip.txt
scripts.lint:depcruise:ci: mkdir -p tmp/reports/linters && bunx depcruise . --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type json --output-to tmp/reports/linters/depcruise.json
scripts.lint:jscpd:ci: mkdir -p tmp/reports/linters && bunx jscpd . --reporters json,console --output tmp/reports/linters/jscpd
scripts.lint:ast-grep:ci: mkdir -p tmp/reports/linters && mise exec -- ast-grep scan --error --report-style=rich | tee tmp/reports/linters/ast-grep.txt
scripts.lint:mise:ci: mkdir -p tmp/reports/linters && mise exec -- tombi check mise.toml | tee tmp/reports/linters/mise.txt
scripts.lint:depcruise:graph: bunx depcruise . --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --include-only '^.' --output-type dot | dot -T svg > report/dependency-graph.svg
scripts.lint: e=0; bun run typecheck || e=1; bun run lint:biome || e=1; bun run lint:knip || e=1; bun run lint:depcruise || e=1; bun run lint:mise || e=1; bun run lint:jscpd || e=1; bun run lint:ls || e=1; bun run lint:ast-grep || e=1; exit $e
scripts.lint:fix: e=0; bun run lint:biome:fix || e=1; bun run lint:knip:fix || e=1; bun run lint:ast-grep:fix || e=1; exit $e

@release-it/conventional-changelog.header:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.
